title: Digital beamformer on GPUs
highlights: Implemented GPU-accelerated digital beamforming with CUDA, speeding up signal processing and reducing computation times, achieving 66.89% adjusted R-squared in variance explanation.
Optimized real-time CUDA kernels for signal manipulation and used cuFFT for fast frequency transformations, contributing to a dynamic beamforming architecture used in radar and communication systems.

details.heading: How it works
details.body: Simulates signals from a phased array antenna and aligns them with programmable phase shifts to enhance one direction and suppress noise. Implements time-domain beamforming (delays align the signals before combining) and frequency-domain beamforming (FFT with complex weights per frequency bin, using cuFFT). Built with C/C++ and nvcc and run on a GPU cluster.
